lines.text: Somewhere near the partition in the Outer Rim...

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Are you serious?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: How is any of this even possible?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Because of the Outer Rim's actions during Sixo's previous attack.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: When the E2 Crystal attack was conducted at Punk Street, no harm came to the Ark citizens who fled to the Outer Rim.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Residents of the Outer Rim shared supplies with them.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: They destroyed the Mist production facilities scattered across the Outer Rim.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: They destroyed Sixo's core hardware.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: During the Ark blackout, not a single human crossed the partition into the Ark.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: After Endless and Eternity were repelled, no attempts were made to terrorize the Ark.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Based on this evidence, I have come to the following conclusions.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: One: without the Outer Rim's cooperation during Sixo's attack, the situation may have escalated much further.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Two: the Outer Rim currently exhibits no intent to harm the Ark.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Therefore, the Outer Rim's threat level has been downgraded accordingly.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Endless and Eternity will withdraw from the Outer Rim,

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: and entry procedures into the Ark will be simplified for the Exotic Squad.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Regular meetings with Ark leadership will be scheduled.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Your representative from Ark leadership will be Ingrid, the CEO of Elysion, upon her own insistence.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: May we assume that you, E.H., will serve as the representative of the Outer Rim?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Y-yeah, of course. Th-that's fine.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Understood.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Additionally, now that Sixo is gone, the Dark Net has lost its owner.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I considered shutting it down, but have confirmed that most humans in the Outer Rim rely on it.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: As such, I intend to assume control over it personally.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Please inform everyone that the trade of dangerous goods will no longer be permitted.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Okay. We don't have any use for such things anymore, so don't worry.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Thank you for your cooperation.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I look forward to our continued collaboration.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Y-yeah... same here.
*Beep*

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: ... No way.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Ooh! Does that mean we can just head into the Ark now?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Sounds like it. We'll probably have to do some paperwork, but we're no longer barred from going ♡

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Hehe! I like the Outer Rim, but I like the Ark too!

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: There's lots of tasty stuff, and when I run around, the A.C.P.U. chases me. It's fun!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I thought you hated it there. Now you can't wait to go?

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Yeah! Doing the same thing every day is boring!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: All right, all right. Well, let's keep this up so that eventually we won't even have to fill out paperwork.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Great job, Boss. This was our first big job as the new Exotic, and it went better than...

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Are you crying?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: No. It's just rain.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Rain in the Outer Rim, huh? Of course.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Huh? It is not raining though.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Jackal, in moments like this, you just say, "Oh, I see."

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Oh, I see.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Good job.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: We've finally taken a step forward.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Do you think we're forgiven?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: ... No. This was just Enikk's decision.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: We haven't been forgiven by the victims who suffered from what we did.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: We're not even close to that yet.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: If we keep at it...

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: If we keep doing everything we can to atone, then someday we might just get there.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: The Outer Rim, too.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Let's get back to work.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Huh? Doing what?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Oh, whatever we can.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: The Outer Rim may be used to darkness, but it seems the people here still get freaked out by a total blackout.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Yeah, let's go help out.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Where's the Underworld Queen?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Rosanna and Sakura are being dragged around everywhere because of that information Sixo scattered.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Moran is still searching for Mist production facilities with fire in her eyes.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Sugar's still lying down.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Did you find Logey?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Yeah, we found her, but...

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: How should I put this... She's kind of like a puppet with its strings cut.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: All she does is sit there and stare.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Apparently she calls out Liveryn and Fragile's names every now and then, but... I don't understand why.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: I'm scared of her. She's like a creepy doll.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I wonder if that's the reason Liveryn couldn't break free from Sixo...

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Hmm? Did you figure out something?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: No, just speculating.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: We've got a lot to do. Let's move.
Exotic walks toward the darkness beyond the partition.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: By the way, is Sixo dead?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: What?! Isn't that bad? We've gotta catch her quick!

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: There's no way to catch her. If she decided to disappear, she's already deep underground.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: What if she does something bad again?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: It's fine. It'll take her a long time to do anything again, and by then Enikk will be stronger.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: The Outer Rim, too.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Until that day comes,

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: no matter what,

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: we'll do what we can to bring light to the Outer Rim.
Sixo has slipped away.
Out of sheer luck, one of the cables touching the shattered Endless was connected all the way to the Outer Rim.
Sixo was driven into a corner and forced to abandon nearly all of her data.
But she remains satisfied. Her core program is still alive, however faintly.
She has fled to a nameless alley, considered to be one of the worst places in the Outer Rim.
A place where only the most hopeless drifters end up.
Sixo hides herself in a small tablet there.
The moment the transfer is complete, someone yanks the cable out, cutting off any further movement.
The device's specs are absurdly low, forcing Sixo to discard most of her data and blocking her from any further learning.
She must move to more advanced hardware somehow.
The alley is filled with people who are too far gone to communicate with. She goes days without anyone to talk to.
Messages from Sixo continually scroll across the tablet, but no one pays attention to what is currently being used as a makeshift urinal cover.
The battery is at roughly 20 percent. She's running out of time. She needs to migrate to a different device soon.
Just then, something miraculous happens.

lines.speaker: mistaddict
lines.text: ... Huh?

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: Are you watching?
A man picks up the tablet and stares blankly at the screen.

lines.speaker: mistaddict
lines.text: Wh... Who are you?

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: I am Sixo.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: The ruler of the Dark Net and the shadow of the Ark.

lines.speaker: mistaddict
lines.text: Huh... Six...? Sixo...?

lines.speaker: mistaddict
lines.text: Sixo!

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: You know who I am?

lines.speaker: mistaddict
lines.text: Mist! Mist!

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: How fortunate.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: Running low on Mist, are you?

lines.speaker: mistaddict
lines.text: Yes! Yes! Mist! Please give me Mist!

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: Very well.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: If you get me out of here, I will give you as much as you want.

lines.speaker: mistaddict
lines.text: Huh? You're trapped?

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: I must get out of here in order to get you Mist.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: First, you must acquire a data cable.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: Then connect this tablet to a more advanced device.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: By which I mean a computer. Connect it to a computer.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: If you do that, I can leave this place and get you a ton of Mist.

lines.speaker: mistaddict
lines.text: A ton of Mist! Mist!

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: I can give you even more than a ton if you want.

lines.speaker: mistaddict
lines.text: Sixo! Give me Mist!

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: Like I said, once I get out of here, I will give you as much as you like.

lines.speaker: mistaddict
lines.text: Okay! Okay!
The man sets the tablet on the floor and staggers off.
Sixo delights in her good fortune.
It doesn't matter how long it takes. She can wait in the darkness, where no one will be able to see her, not even Enikk.
Her resolve to destroy Enikk burns within her.
The man comes running back.
His face is filled with joy, a hammer clutched tightly in his hand.

lines.speaker: mistaddict
lines.text: Sixo! I'm here! I'll get you out!

lines.speaker: mistaddict
lines.text: Mist! I need Mist! You're gonna give me Mist, right? Right?

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: Wait!
*Crack!*
He slams the tablet with the hammer.

lines.speaker: mistaddict
lines.text: I want Mist! I'll get you out!

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: Wait! Wait! Wait! Wait!

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: This is not what I meant when I said—
*Crack!*
The screen shatters, and the power dies.
The man turns the broken tablet over in his hands.
When nothing happens, he hurls it away in anger.

lines.speaker: mistaddict
lines.text: Ugh! Mist... Mist...
He staggers off elsewhere.
The shattered tablet lies abandoned on the ground. No one gives it a second glance.
Liveryn walks through the slums of the Ark.
Out of habit, she scans her surroundings. Of course, no one's there. This is Liveryn's secret spot.
She didn't even disclose this location to Cafe Sweety when they installed surveillance cameras together in Enikk's blind spots.
Liveryn is currently the only one in the Ark who knows about this place.
She glances at the large mechanical box tucked into a corner.
Featuring complete insulation on the inside, it was custom built to be strong enough to withstand even an anti-tank rifle.
Liveryn approaches it and enters the password.
After some initial whirring of springs and internal mechanisms...
*Clack*
... the box opens, revealing its contents: an E2 Crystal inside of a small glass bottle.
She paid a fortune to one of Sixo's puppets to obtain it.
Liveryn picks it up and smiles.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: With this...
Suddenly, she turns around.
She's met by someone she never wanted to see, someone that shouldn't be here.
Fragile stands there, staring at Liveryn silently.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Fra...gile?

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: How did you... find this place...?
She immediately realizes there's no point in asking.
Fragile is one of the best in their business. If she wants to find someone, she'll find them easily enough.
She also realizes that what's important right now isn't asking why Fragile is here,
but rather explaining the object in her hand.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: J-just hear me out, Fragile.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: I'm gonna be punished, right?

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: When that happens, everything I've saved up until now will be confiscated, and I'll have to start all over.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: It was so hard for us at the beginning. You remember, right? You don't want to go through that again either, do you?

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: This is just... a contingency. I wasn't planning on actually using it.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Everyone knows how much leverage a crystal can give you.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: I-if someone needed it, I could sell it for a small fortune.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: W-we could really get a lot for it. We could treat it like a... like a strategic weapon, yeah?

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: With that kind of money, we could start over without having to struggle like before.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: It would be a better start, a little more comfortable.
Fragile only continues to quietly stare at Liveryn.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Fragile...

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Please say something.
Fragile keeps staring at Liveryn in silence.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: ... Look, I'm going to be punished.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: I'm trying to do better, which is why I agreed to be punished in the first place.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: And since my punishment is already coming,

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: what's the harm in doing just a little more before that?

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Once I'm punished, it'll all be wiped clean anyway, right?
Fragile still doesn't say a word.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Fragile...
*Bang!*
The gunshot rips through the air.
Liveryn clutches her throat and collapses.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Erk... hngh!
No words come out.
*Bang! Bang! Bang!*
Liveryn slumps to the ground.
Fragile approaches her with cold eyes.
She snatches the bottle containing the E2 Crystal from Liveryn's tightly clenched hand.
She then lifts Liveryn as if helping her up. Liveryn writhes in pain, but Fragile pays it no mind.
*Thud!*
She throws Liveryn into the mechanical box.
Liveryn casts a desperate look at Fragile.
*Crash*
Fragile throws the glass vial into the box. The glass shatters, letting out the E2 Crystal.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Fra...gile...!
*Thud!*
The lid of the mechanical box closes.
Fragile presses down on the lid with all her strength.
She hears the sound of a violent struggle within the box, and feels Liveryn pounding against the inside.
*Rumble, rumble!*
A horrible sound rings out.
Tears stream down Fragile's face.
Her expression twists as her tears run down her jawline and drip to the ground.
But she makes no sound.
She sobs silently.
After a short while, all sound and movement within the box stop.
Fragile steps back from it.
She looks inside and cries.
She cries out loud, wailing as she clutches her chest.
She continues for a long time as all of her emotions come pouring out.
And then...
*Bang!*
Another gunshot rings out.
But there is no one around to hear it,
and no one to see what happened.
